operator_io_quirks: Table/column names mixed case (Musical_ID, Name, age); must double-quote in generated SQL.

actor.Musical_ID FK points to actor(Actor_ID) — a SELF-reference on the same table, not to musical. Upstream process_order must ignore table self-edges; FK fill draws from actor.Actor_ID's own final values.
FK parent column Actor_ID is the PK (unique) but the FK is semantically wrong (musical IDs stored in actor.Musical_ID, values 1,2,4,6 overlap musical.Musical_ID 1..7). No real FK to musical exists.
musical.Year declared INT, distinct=1 (all 1986) — Number fuzzer will scatter wildly; no date semantics.
actor.Duration declared TEXT but holds year-range strings ('1988—', '1988, 1992—', '1988–2008, 2013') with en-dashes/commas; String fuzzer, not Date.
musical.Category long text with spaces/commas; String fuzzer length range from samples.
musical.Name contains non-ASCII (Les Misérables) — CHARSET a-zA-Z0-9() will not reproduce accents.
All columns notnull=0, no CHECK/UNIQUE constraints beyond PKs; insert failures only from PK dupes (already filtered).
Tiny tables (7 and 9 rows) — choose_table_sizes will still request 30..2500 rows; PK/unique filtering shrinks but Number PKs rarely collide.
musical.Award/Nominee/Result low cardinality (2 distinct) — String sampler will mostly reuse elements.
No views/triggers/indexes beyond PK; DDL clone trivial.
actor.age INT small ints (18-26); Number fuzzer range ±10^scale.
operator_ts_expectations: musical.Musical_ID / actor.Actor_ID: Number fuzzer, int, scale from INT (no args) -> range ±10^scale, perturb ±1/±2; PK uniqueness filter keeps first occurrence.
musical.Year: Number fuzzer over single value 1986 -> list range quirk (min(el), full max) so fresh draws span huge range; likely FN on Year predicates.

musical.Name/Category/Nominee/Award/Result, actor.Name/Character/Duration: String fuzzer, length range from samples, 0.5 contaminate; Duration year-strings get random suffix/prefix — implausible but TS-consistent.
actor.Musical_ID: FK fill from actor.Actor_ID final values (self-ref) — values will be actor IDs, not musical IDs; queries joining actor->musical on Musical_ID will mostly miss (FP/FN).
No real FK to musical means joins musical.Actor implicitly via Musical_ID equality are not enforced; TS will not create matching pairs.
p=0.2 default, whole-instance p=0 w.p. 0.3 -> some instances pure element reuse (ties/duplicates), others fresh.
max_l0 cap (rng*30) on non-PK columns -> repeated fresh values, driving duplicate-heavy results.
Low-cardinality columns (Award, Result, Nominee) -> many ties; ORDER BY / DISTINCT queries may match by luck (FP) or miss (FN).
Year single distinct -> any 'Year = 1986' predicate: original all-true, TS mostly false (FN).
Duration text with en-dash: LIKE '%1988%' may still match after contamination (prefix/suffix keeps substring).
Self-FK: upstream draws child FK from parent's FINAL filtered column, so actor.Musical_ID values are a subset of actor.Actor_ID — self-join actor on Musical_ID=Actor_ID plausible.
Tiny originals: TS sizes 30-2500 rows vs 7-9 -> cardinality-sensitive queries (COUNT, aggregates) diverge.
